review_candidates.title: Project Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Factory Egypt is a specialist organization providing technical services in electromechanical systems for a wide range of industrial and commercial clients. The company combines deep technical knowledge with creative problem-solving to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions. Services span the full project lifecycle, from consulting and solution recommendations to installation management. Factory Egypt also provides rigorous quality control and ongoing maintenance support to help clients keep their systems operating efficiently and safely. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Project Engineer role based in Cairo, Egypt. The Project Engineer will oversee electromechanical projects from initial planning through execution and handover, ensuring technical accuracy, safety, and adherence to client requirements. Day-to-day responsibilities include developing project plans, coordinating with internal teams and external stakeholders, preparing technical documentation, and monitoring progress against timelines and budgets. The role involves supporting installation activities, conducting inspections and quality checks, and troubleshooting technical issues on-site. The Project Engineer will also assist in recommending technical solutions to clients and contribute to continuous improvement of project delivery processes. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Project Engineering and Electrical Engineering skills, with hands-on experience in electromechanical systems. Candidates should possess solid Project Management and Project Planning skills, including scheduling, resource coordination, and risk management. Candidates should possess effective Communication skills, enabling clear interaction with clients, contractors, and multidisciplinary teams. Relevant bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. Experience in industrial or commercial projects, preferably within electromechanical or technical services environments. Ability to interpret technical drawings and specifications, and apply applicable codes and standards. Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and commitment to safety and quality. Proficiency with project management and engineering software tools; fluency in English and Arabic is an advantage.

review_candidates.description: Since launching in Kuwait in 2004, talabat, the leading on-demand food and Q-commerce app for everyday deliveries, has been offering convenience and reliability to its customers. talabat’s local roots run deep, offering a real understanding of the needs of the communities we serve in eight countries across the region.We harness innovative technology and knowledge to simplify everyday life for our customers, optimize operations for our restaurants and local shops, and provide our riders with reliable earning opportunities daily. Here at talabat, we are building a high performance culture through engaged workforce and growing talent density. We're all about keeping it real and making a difference. Our 6,000+ strong talabaty are on an awesome mission to spread positive vibes. We are proud to be a multi great place to work award winner. Job Description Job Description A Little Bit About Our Engineering Culture We love finding new ways to shorten the feedback loops, create together and make an impact. To do so, our engineering culture and practices are based on eXtreme Programming (XP), Domain-Driven Design, Lean and Continuous Delivery. We believe that the assumption behind the “Speed vs Quality” mindset is flawed and that you can both have your cake and eat it too. For us, quality enables speed. Not in 2 years, but now. Co-creating together with others through Pair and Mob programming helps us deliver more value sooner and find joy in our work by seeking productive human connections with others. We find that engineers seeking to understand our product and business better understand the context of their work, which helps them to innovate, deliver more value to their customers and find more purpose in their work. Role Summary Alongside your team counterparts (product, design, data), understand your customer/business needs/desires/problems to drive desired outcomes and create a strategy to drive desire outcomes Lead, inspire and empower a talented group of engineers to self-organize and discover, innovate, implement, deploy and own end-to-end complex software solutions Develop and grow engineering talent through effective mentoring, coaching, and retention strategies in a hyper-growing, highly competitive economic environment Guide your team in creation of software as a solution to an end-to-end problem in your business domain and deliver value in small batches, taking into account non-functional requirements such as availability, scalability, latency and efficiency of talabat’s services in line with our internal engineering standards. Guide your team’s discovery, planning and execution to successfully deliver value to our customers in small batches Qualifications The following experience is relevant to us Good understanding of lean/agile values & principles and associated practices 6+ years of experience in software engineering, preferably within Extreme Programming environment (TDD, Pair Programming, Simple Design, and Continuous Refactoring) 2+ years of hands-on technical leadership and people management experience Experience in Distributed Systems Architecture (Microservices, Event-Driven, and RESTful Services) Experience building, maintaining & improving with Trunk Based Development and Continuous Delivery Solid experience in designing, implementing, monitoring and scaling of web apps and APIs Solid understanding of the full mobile development life cycle Strong familiarity with the general mobile landscape, architectures, trends/emerging tech Proficient in testing with focus on automated end to end quality Experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS Strong understanding of quality, performance, monitoring, alerting and security standards

review_candidates.title: Pricing Analyst
review_candidates.description: We're hiring a Pricing Analyst – CX/BPO EXPERIENCE Is A Must. ROLE PURPOSE: The Pricing Expert prices CX opportunities end-to-end: translating client RFP/RFI requirements into solid cost models and competitive commercial proposals. The role requires a real understanding of how a customer operation runs – operations, WFM, training, quality, support functions – and a hands-on use of AI tools to analyze and translate RFP/RFI documents faster and better. review_candidates.title: Bid Coordinator
review_candidates.description: Bid Coordinator Company: United Delta for Information Technology Department: Commercial / Bid Management Reports To: Bid Manager Location: Cairo, Egypt Employment Type: Full-Time About United Delta United Delta is a technology and digital transformation company delivering enterprise solutions across the Middle East. Our capabilities span Hyperautomation & Low-Code, Middleware & API Management, Artificial Intelligence, Data & Analytics, CRM, Enterprise Digital Solutions, and Airport Digital Transformation. We work closely with leading technology partners and enterprise and government customers to deliver complex digital transformation initiatives across the region. Role Overview United Delta is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Bid Coordinator to support our Bid Manager and wider commercial team in managing the end-to-end coordination of proposals, tenders, RFPs, RFIs, and other bid submissions. The Bid Coordinator will play a key role in ensuring that bid activities are properly planned, coordinated, documented, and submitted on time. The successful candidate will work closely with Sales, Presales, Delivery, Finance, Legal, Technology Practices, Partners, and Management to collect and consolidate the information required for high-quality and compliant submissions. This role is particularly suited to someone who is highly organized, comfortable working under deadlines, and capable of coordinating multiple stakeholders and bids simultaneously. Key Responsibilities Bid & Proposal Coordination Support the Bid Manager in coordinating the complete bid lifecycle for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, tenders, proposals, and related commercial submissions. Review tender and RFP documentation to identify submission requirements, deadlines, mandatory documents, formats, and evaluation criteria. Prepare and maintain bid checklists, compliance matrices, submission trackers, and action plans. Coordinate the collection of technical, commercial, legal, financial, and administrative inputs from internal stakeholders. Track outstanding actions and proactively follow up with contributors to ensure deadlines are met. Coordinate clarifications and questions related to tender requirements. Support the preparation, formatting, consolidation, proofreading, and quality review of proposal documents. Ensure final submissions comply with customer instructions and United Delta's internal standards. Coordinate electronic and physical bid submissions where required. Internal Stakeholder Coordination Work closely with the Bid Manager, Sales, Presales, Delivery, Finance, Legal, HR, and Technology Practice teams throughout the bid process. Schedule and coordinate bid kick-off meetings, review sessions, and final submission reviews. Document agreed actions, owners, and deadlines and ensure appropriate follow-up. Escalate potential delays, missing inputs, compliance risks, and other bid-related issues to the Bid Manager. Support coordination with subcontractors and technology partners for quotations, Statements of Work, technical documentation, certifications, and other required inputs. Proposal Documentation & Quality Maintain United Delta's proposal templates and ensure consistent use of approved corporate formats. Support the preparation and maintenance of standard company information, capability statements, customer references, CVs, certifications, project references, and other reusable bid content. Review submissions for formatting, consistency, completeness, grammar, and overall presentation quality. Ensure appropriate document version control throughout the bid lifecycle. Maintain accurate records of submitted proposals and their supporting documentation. Bid Tracking & Reporting Maintain an up-to-date tracker of active, upcoming, submitted, won, lost, and cancelled bids. Track key bid milestones, submission dates, clarification deadlines, and dependencies. Support the Bid Manager in preparing regular bid status reports for management. Maintain records of bid outcomes and support win/loss analysis. Help maintain an organized repository of previous proposals, RFP responses, customer requirements, commercial documents, and reusable content. Support continuous improvement of United Delta's bid management processes, templates, and knowledge base. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 1–3 years of experience in bid coordination, proposal management, sales support, commercial operations, project coordination, or a similar role. Previous experience within an IT services, systems integration, consulting, software, or technology organization is highly preferred. Exposure to government or enterprise RFPs and tendering processes in Saudi Arabia or the GCC is an advantage. Experience coordinating multiple internal and external stakeholders under strict deadlines is highly desirable. Required Skills Excellent organizational and coordination skills. Strong attention to detail. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Arabic and English. Arabic communication skills are highly desirable. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and related productivity tools. Ability to understand and follow complex RFP instructions and compliance requirements. Strong document formatting and presentation skills. Effective stakeholder management and follow-up capabilities. Ability to manage multiple bids and competing deadlines simultaneously. Strong sense of ownership and accountability. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment. Preferred Attributes We are looking for someone who is: Highly organized – able to keep multiple submissions, documents, actions, and deadlines under control. Detail-oriented – capable of identifying missing information, inconsistencies, and compliance gaps. Proactive – follows up without waiting to be reminded. Deadline-driven – understands that bid submission deadlines are non-negotiable. Collaborative – comfortable coordinating with senior stakeholders across different functions. Commercially aware – understands that every proposal ultimately supports a business opportunity. Calm under pressure – able to maintain quality even during demanding submission periods. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance in this role will be measured against areas including: On-time bid submission rate. Bid compliance and completeness. Accuracy of bid documentation. Timely collection of stakeholder inputs. Quality and consistency of proposal documentation. Bid tracker and repository accuracy. Reduction in last-minute submission issues. Internal stakeholder responsiveness and coordination. Contribution to improving United Delta's overall bid management process. Working Relationship with the Bid Manager The Bid Coordinator will work closely with the Bid Manager , who will retain overall ownership of bid strategy, governance, commercial positioning, and final submission quality. The Bid Coordinator will primarily ensure that the operational and coordination aspects of each bid are executed effectively —including tracking requirements, coordinating stakeholders, managing documentation, monitoring deadlines, and ensuring submission readiness. Together, the Bid Manager and Bid Coordinator will ensure that United Delta's bids are compliant, competitive, professionally presented, and delivered on time .

ROLE PURPOSE: The Pricing Expert prices CX opportunities end-to-end: translating client RFP/RFI requirements into solid cost models and competitive commercial proposals. The role requires a real understanding of how a customer operation runs – operations, WFM, training, quality, support functions – and a hands-on use of AI tools to analyze and translate RFP/RFI documents faster and better. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Pricing & Cost Modeling: Build bottom-up pricing models: FTEs, productivity, shrinkage, attrition, ramp, support ratios Structure the right commercial model per deal (per hour, per transaction, per FTE, outcome-based) Run scenarios (volumes, languages, on/near/offshore mix) and secure target margins Ensure pricing meets group margin targets and flag deviations with clear, quantified recommendations RFP/RFI & Bid Support: Translate client requirements (SLAs, volumes, coverage, language mix) into pricing assumptions Use AI tools to parse, summarize, and translate multilingual RFP/RFI documentation Own the pricing sections of proposals, working closely with solutions, operations, and sale Operational Expertise & Governance: Challenge operational assumptions (AHT, occupancy, training duration, attrition) with credibility Cost all layers of the operating model: front-line operations, WFM, training, quality, team leadership, and support functions Continuously improve pricing templates and automate recurring modeling tasks Maintain cost and productivity benchmarks to sanity-check every model Prepare pricing approval materials and support negotiations with rapid what-if analyses PROFILE 2+ years in pricing, solutioning, or commercial finance within the CX / BPO industry Deep knowledge of customer operations models and their cost drivers Advanced Excel / financial modeling skills Hands-on user of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot...) for document analysis and translation English profile: B2 Autonomous, rigorous, comfortable with tight bid deadlines

This includes acting as a design consultant to faculty and partners, assisting them translate learning outcomes and goals into effective digital learning experiences. The role ensures that courses reflect principles of active learning, Universal Design for Learning (UDL), and accessibility. He or She will also verify that instructional strategies are carefully aligned with assessment and learner engagement across modalities. Responsibilities: Instructional Design and Consultancy: Collaborate with faculty and subject matter experts to create high quality online and blended learning courses , design accessible, active, and standards-aligned digital learning experiences that effectively translate learning outcomes Ensures that courses align with program goals, reflect principles of active learning, Universal Design for Learning (UDL), accessibility, and that instructional strategies are intentionally aligned with assessments and learner engagement across digital learning modalities Course Development and Support: Oversee the quality and pedagogical value of digital learning activities and materials used in courses. This includes guiding the design and production of digital learning experiences, interactive media, and other digital assets that support both synchronous and asynchronous learning The role ensures that content is pedagogically purposeful and appropriate for the learning context, while also enabling faculty to use different platforms effectively to sustain and update their own course materials Training and Collaboration: Build capacity across the Center for Learning and Teaching (CLT) and academic community for effective digital teaching and learning. new_matches.title: Bid Coordinator
new_matches.description: Bid Coordinator Company: United Delta for Information Technology Department: Commercial / Bid Management Reports To: Bid Manager Location: Cairo, Egypt Employment Type: Full-Time About United Delta United Delta is a technology and digital transformation company delivering enterprise solutions across the Middle East. Our capabilities span Hyperautomation & Low-Code, Middleware & API Management, Artificial Intelligence, Data & Analytics, CRM, Enterprise Digital Solutions, and Airport Digital Transformation. We work closely with leading technology partners and enterprise and government customers to deliver complex digital transformation initiatives across the region. Role Overview United Delta is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Bid Coordinator to support our Bid Manager and wider commercial team in managing the end-to-end coordination of proposals, tenders, RFPs, RFIs, and other bid submissions. The Bid Coordinator will play a key role in ensuring that bid activities are properly planned, coordinated, documented, and submitted on time. The successful candidate will work closely with Sales, Presales, Delivery, Finance, Legal, Technology Practices, Partners, and Management to collect and consolidate the information required for high-quality and compliant submissions. This role is particularly suited to someone who is highly organized, comfortable working under deadlines, and capable of coordinating multiple stakeholders and bids simultaneously. Key Responsibilities Bid & Proposal Coordination Support the Bid Manager in coordinating the complete bid lifecycle for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, tenders, proposals, and related commercial submissions. Review tender and RFP documentation to identify submission requirements, deadlines, mandatory documents, formats, and evaluation criteria. Prepare and maintain bid checklists, compliance matrices, submission trackers, and action plans. Coordinate the collection of technical, commercial, legal, financial, and administrative inputs from internal stakeholders. Track outstanding actions and proactively follow up with contributors to ensure deadlines are met. Coordinate clarifications and questions related to tender requirements. Support the preparation, formatting, consolidation, proofreading, and quality review of proposal documents. Ensure final submissions comply with customer instructions and United Delta's internal standards. Coordinate electronic and physical bid submissions where required. Internal Stakeholder Coordination Work closely with the Bid Manager, Sales, Presales, Delivery, Finance, Legal, HR, and Technology Practice teams throughout the bid process. Schedule and coordinate bid kick-off meetings, review sessions, and final submission reviews. Document agreed actions, owners, and deadlines and ensure appropriate follow-up. Escalate potential delays, missing inputs, compliance risks, and other bid-related issues to the Bid Manager. Support coordination with subcontractors and technology partners for quotations, Statements of Work, technical documentation, certifications, and other required inputs. Proposal Documentation & Quality Maintain United Delta's proposal templates and ensure consistent use of approved corporate formats. Support the preparation and maintenance of standard company information, capability statements, customer references, CVs, certifications, project references, and other reusable bid content. Review submissions for formatting, consistency, completeness, grammar, and overall presentation quality. Ensure appropriate document version control throughout the bid lifecycle. Maintain accurate records of submitted proposals and their supporting documentation. Bid Tracking & Reporting Maintain an up-to-date tracker of active, upcoming, submitted, won, lost, and cancelled bids. Track key bid milestones, submission dates, clarification deadlines, and dependencies. Support the Bid Manager in preparing regular bid status reports for management. Maintain records of bid outcomes and support win/loss analysis. Help maintain an organized repository of previous proposals, RFP responses, customer requirements, commercial documents, and reusable content. Support continuous improvement of United Delta's bid management processes, templates, and knowledge base. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 1–3 years of experience in bid coordination, proposal management, sales support, commercial operations, project coordination, or a similar role. Previous experience within an IT services, systems integration, consulting, software, or technology organization is highly preferred. Exposure to government or enterprise RFPs and tendering processes in Saudi Arabia or the GCC is an advantage. Experience coordinating multiple internal and external stakeholders under strict deadlines is highly desirable. Required Skills Excellent organizational and coordination skills. Strong attention to detail. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Arabic and English. Arabic communication skills are highly desirable. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and related productivity tools. Ability to understand and follow complex RFP instructions and compliance requirements. Strong document formatting and presentation skills. Effective stakeholder management and follow-up capabilities. Ability to manage multiple bids and competing deadlines simultaneously. Strong sense of ownership and accountability. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment. Preferred Attributes We are looking for someone who is: Highly organized – able to keep multiple submissions, documents, actions, and deadlines under control. Detail-oriented – capable of identifying missing information, inconsistencies, and compliance gaps. Proactive – follows up without waiting to be reminded. Deadline-driven – understands that bid submission deadlines are non-negotiable. Collaborative – comfortable coordinating with senior stakeholders across different functions. Commercially aware – understands that every proposal ultimately supports a business opportunity. Calm under pressure – able to maintain quality even during demanding submission periods. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance in this role will be measured against areas including: On-time bid submission rate. Bid compliance and completeness. Accuracy of bid documentation. Timely collection of stakeholder inputs. Quality and consistency of proposal documentation. Bid tracker and repository accuracy. Reduction in last-minute submission issues. Internal stakeholder responsiveness and coordination. Contribution to improving United Delta's overall bid management process. Working Relationship with the Bid Manager The Bid Coordinator will work closely with the Bid Manager , who will retain overall ownership of bid strategy, governance, commercial positioning, and final submission quality. The Bid Coordinator will primarily ensure that the operational and coordination aspects of each bid are executed effectively —including tracking requirements, coordinating stakeholders, managing documentation, monitoring deadlines, and ensuring submission readiness. Together, the Bid Manager and Bid Coordinator will ensure that United Delta's bids are compliant, competitive, professionally presented, and delivered on time .
